page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage and baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place the ecs.g5ne.2xlarge primarily in the lower tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench register in the bottom 25%, as do memory bandwidth read speeds and database operations. However, the instance achieves average tier results in PassMark CPU score and PassMark CPU extended instructions. Large-block memory write bandwidth also performs in the middle 50% tier at 34.64 GB/sec, while LLM inference speeds for small 135M models remain average.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its lower compute and read memory bandwidth relative to newer hardware generations, which limits its utility for heavy data processing or large language model inference. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio provide a stable resource profile for workloads that do not require high-speed local disk I/O or intensive mathematical computation. It is best utilized for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, small-scale application hosting, and lightweight background tasks.
